title: Heavenly Pollaxe
body:
"An axe forged by the gods of the moon! This gravity including axe lower the weight of objects, and makes them float."

Description

The Heavenly Pollaxe is an axe added on the 2024 Halloween Event. It is made by combining the Hardened Moon Rod with a Waxing Gibbous Moon Shard at the top of the Manor.

Appearance

The Heavenly Pollaxe is a large sized axe, with a texture close to marble. It has a spiked headpiece and a shape resembling a halberd, and a small hexagonal hole just below the headpiece. The axe head is white in color while the handle is a light grey.

Trivia

  • The swing speed is the same as the Reinforced Axe.
  • Previously, the anti-gravity effect applied by the axe makes things have negative gravity while holding the Gravity coil or the fusion coil. As of 7-10-2024, this glitch has been patched.
  • There is a rare chance when using the Bandsaw to cut wood that had been cut with the Heavenly Pollaxe, the wood will have permanently reversed gravity.
  • The axe itself emanates a small amount of light, and has a highlight
